paper_sections.title: Neural correlates of positive and negative emotion regulation.

description.value: The study examined how cognitively increasing and decreasing emotional reactions to positive and negative pictures affect subjective emotion and neural activity, particularly in prefrontal regions and the amygdala.

spans.text: We used event-related functional magnetic resonance imaging to examine the neural correlates of cognitively increasing and decreasing emotional reactions to positive and negative stimuli.
